# Data Safety Checklist: st-update

**Purpose**: Check that the spec fully defines how st-update protects user files, untracked settings and branches while it changes many folders.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is every user data file that st-update must never change named? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the exact Stratum lines and keys that st-update may add or change listed for each committed file? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the content of each new item defined (the exact `.gitignore` lines, pointer lines and settings keys), or is st-init named as the source? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the commit message form for the per-branch commits defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "a Stratum statusline path" defined so that a custom command can be told apart from an old Stratum path? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "a Stratum name" in `permissions.allow` defined precisely enough to avoid removing a user's own entry? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "the marketplace version" defined for a marketplace that is not a local directory? [Clarity, Assumption]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Does FR-010 (no change before the OK) agree with FR-014 (questions after the gate), so that no question writes a file before the OK? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK009 Does FR-012 (repoint after update) agree with FR-011 when the update fails in a folder? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Is the order of steps defined when a folder's plugin update fails: is `statusLine` left as it was? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the requirements defined for a commit the commit guard denies, in the main checkout and in a worktree? [Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is recovery defined if st-update stops halfway (some folders done, some not)? Does a second run pick up the rest? [Recovery, Gap, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for a live worker session in a worktree while st-update runs? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Is the behavior defined when `.claude/settings.local.json` is missing or is not valid JSON? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the behavior defined for an install record with a scope other than `local` or `project` (for example `user`)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the behavior defined for a discontinued file that the user changed since Stratum wrote it? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-015]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK017 Is the dependency on the `claude plugin update` CLI and its output documented, with what st-update does when the CLI is missing? [Dependency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the assumption that the config folder comes from `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` checked against the work wrapper (`~/.claude-work`)? [Assumption]

## Notes

- CHK010, CHK012, CHK014, CHK015 and CHK017 got edge cases in the spec on 2026-11-04. CHK004 (commit message form) is for the plan.
